title: Classical boundaries and ordinary site comparison
statement: For a finite commutative ring A, scheme X, monomorphism j:W to V in the small etale site, and A-module sheaf F, the canonical comparison of derived evaluations at every etale object is invertible in every nonnegative degree. On both sites there exists a support boundary normalized on every injective resolution as in [def-pur-rank-one-local-data].

proof.text: Comparison direct image preserves injectives, and derived comparison has invertible unit. Apply its composition comparison after evaluation to show that pulled-back injectives are evaluation-acyclic. The canonical derived base-change transformation is therefore invertible. The adopted library proves these comparison properties.

Restriction of an injective sheaf along a monomorphism is surjective: its presheaf is injective, and lift the represented free section map along the induced monomorphism of free Yoneda presheaves. The support section complex is thus short exact. Define its snake boundary on a fixed resolution; lifting the identity between resolutions and snake naturality prove the prescribed normalization on every resolution.

theorem classical_support_comparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {V W : X.Etale} (j : W ⟶ V) [Mono j]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) :
    (∀ (T : X.Etale) (q : ℕ), IsIso ((comparisonCohomology A X T q).app F)) ∧
    (∃ δet, IsBoundary X.smallEtaleTopology A j F δet) ∧
    (∃ δpro, IsBoundary (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) A ((Scheme.toProEt X).map j)
      (proCoefficient A X F) δpro)
